endorsements.quote: Implement participatory design processes that actively involve all stakeholders throughout the stages of AI development.

Haan et al. have observed that additional patient education regarding AI might be necessary to enhance patients’ willingness to accept AI and provide valuable input on the optimal utilization of AI systems [ 14 ].

unlisted_practices: Integrate interdisciplinary expertise from behavioral science, ethics and informatics into AI development to ensure tools are technically sound, interpretable, transparent and aligned with human values.
Apply human-centered design with technology acceptance frameworks such as TAM and UTAUT to guide evidence-based implementation of AI.
Conduct research on how AI affects communication, trust and decision-making among patients, support persons and physicians in clinical encounters.
Involve support persons in AI-assisted care and study their role in clinical decision-making.

screen.reason: This is a letter/perspective advocating for human-centered AI design and patient/support person empowerment in clinical decision-making.
